title: Wheel of Luck
shortDescription: Visitors hit a buzzer or tap the screen to spin a branded wheel and win a prize, a message, or their next step. Instantly understood, full of suspense, and a natural magnet at any stand.
longDescription: A digital prize wheel on a screen or touch pillar, started with a big physical buzzer or a tap. The wheel spins, slows down, and lands on a segment that can unlock a prize, a discount, a fun fact, a message, or the next step in the journey. The organiser sets the odds and the stock per prize, so the main prizes stay rare and the giveaways last all day. Segments, visuals, sounds, languages, and the screen format are configurable, from a monitor at an outdoor tent to a custom installation in a shopping centre. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Understood in a Second
highlights.description: A wheel and a big button need no explanation, so anyone walking past can play right away, from children to seniors.

highlights.title: Prizes Under Control
highlights.description: Set the odds and the stock for each prize, so the main prize stays special and the giveaways last until the end of the event.

highlights.title: Any Format, Any Space
highlights.description: Run it on a monitor, on a touch pillar at a trade fair, or in a custom-built installation with its own buzzer, indoors or out.

highlights.title: More Than a Spin
highlights.description: Add a quiz question before the spin, a code that unlocks a bonus spin, a jackpot hour at a set time, or segments that assign teams or roles for the next activity.

highlights.title: Spin Into Any Story
highlights.description: Back a health campaign about luck and wellbeing, launch a space adventure in a shopping centre, run a sponsor booth at a sports event, or open an advent edition with a new prize each day.

highlights.title: Every Spin Counted
highlights.description: Add a data layer that logs spins, prizes handed out, and optional sign-ups before the spin, so the client can report reach and leads per day.

highlights.title: Keep the Luck Going
highlights.description: Pair with Prize Draw for a main draw at the end of the day, with Visitor Identificator to allow one spin per visitor, or with Live Quiz Show to reward the winners of a round.
